prompt: Which of the following is NOT a built-in Copilot cloud agent security mitigation?
explanation: Per GitHub Docs, Copilot cloud agent CANNOT approve or merge its own PRs. Human review is a required control — auto-merging is a risk, not a mitigation.

options.text: Filtering hidden characters to prevent prompt injection
Restricting internet access via built-in firewall
Automatically approving and merging its own pull requests
Requiring human review before merging draft PRs
